module: Module 6: Independent Sub-Account Margin, Leverage & Stop-Outs
title: Dynamic Leverage Reduction on High-Impact Economic News
precondition: Broker automatically reduces leverage from 1:500 to 1:100 during NFP release.
expected_result: Sizing engine recalculates available group margin; prevents opening oversized orders under reduced leverage.
actual_result: Global leverage reduction schedules update OMS margin coefficients, automatically scaling down order capacity.
